svg.desc: Brindlewick Village Fête / Saturday 6th September, 12 noon – 5pm / Brindlewick Cricket Club, Hawthorn Lane, Brindlewick / In aid of St. Peter's Church Restoration Fund / Attractions: / Grand tombola / Homemade cakes, jams and preserves / BBQ and refreshments / Plant and produce stall / Children's games and bouncy castle / Ferret racing / Live folk music from The Muddy Boots / Local craft and maker stalls / Free entry. All welcome. / Organised by Brindlewick Village Community Association.
